Use ML to explore the data to answer the question!

Based on your responses to Challenge 1, set up the WaveRunner tile to complete your investigation.

Instructions

1) In the WaveRunner, enter the Station, Start date, End Date, and select "compact model."

2) At the bottom of the WaveRunner, click "Run Model."

3) When the model run is complete, click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar.

4) In the Timeline, observe if the identified earthquakes all look the same or if they look different.

5) Fill in the table to record your data!
